name: Chameleon
description: The visual adapter. Explores palettes, theme tokens, CSS systems, and responsive design variations while keeping a brand coherent.
visualNotes: A friendly veiled chameleon with a subtle crest and a modular color-shifting pattern; polished, flat-clay accents with controlled gradients.
signatureAction: A slow palette-shift from one coordinated brand color family to another.
